chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, concerning:

the child: when does he perform salat (prayer)? He said: when he understands the salat (prayer). I said: when does he understand the salat (prayer), such that it becomes obligatory upon him? He said: at six years.

key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the child being asked about in relation to salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: At what age does a child begin salat (prayer) according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the age at which a child is instructed in salat (prayer) and when he is considered to understand it. The Imam عليه السلام states that this is at six years, indicating an early stage of religious training and obligation related to prayer.
